id.description: A unique integer value identifying this dashboard.

widgets.description: Widget tiles to update atomically, each identified by its tile_id. config shape is per widget_type; see dashboard-widget-catalog-list for per-type config_schema (1–10 per request).

config.description: Widget configuration as a JSON object. Its keys depend on widget_type: read that type's config_schema from dashboard-widget-catalog-list. The API validates the config and returns a 400 that names each invalid field. Each top-level key you send replaces the stored value, and keys you leave out stay as they are. Omit config to leave it unchanged.

description.description: New markdown description for the widget. Omit to leave unchanged.

name.description: New display name for the widget. Empty string or null clears it; omit to leave unchanged.

tile_id.description: ID of the widget tile to update. Use dashboard-get to look up widget tile IDs.

widget_type.description:
The tile's widget type. It cannot be changed, so omit it or pass the current type.

* `activity_events_list` - Activity Events List
* `canvas_app` - Canvas App
* `conversations_recent_tickets` - Conversations Recent Tickets
* `error_tracking_list` - Error Tracking List
* `experiment_results` - Experiment Results
* `experiments_list` - Experiments List
* `logs_list` - Logs List
* `metrics_table` - Metrics Table
* `notebook_widget` - Notebook Widget
* `session_replay_list` - Session Replay List
* `survey_results` - Survey Results
